also_in_family_rule: Pages outside the fixed list that are another revision of a listed document (decision 59). Each keeps its group (the host rule still decides maker or dealer) and takes the listed document's family, so the two revisions land in one half. Matched by URL.

reviewed: 29 September 2026, by Claude under Roanuk's instruction to keep progressing: each entry's reason checked against the stored page (copyright line, maker document or part number, or the maker's own host), and each exclusion checked against its URL and title.
